# Worksnaps

Worksnaps is a time-tracking service designed for remote work that offers detailed project and user activity insights.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/worksnaps/.

## Actions

- **Create Project**: Create a new project in worksnaps.
- **Create task**: Create a new task in a specified project.
- **Get Project Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific project.
- **Get Project Report** (read-only): Retrieve a project's time tracking report.
- **Get Project Tasks** (read-only): Retrieve tasks for a specific project.
- **Get Projects** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of projects.
- **Get Task Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific task within a project.
- **Get User Account** (read-only): Retrieve information about a specific user account.
- **Get Users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all users.
- **Update Project**: Update an existing project.
- **Update Task**: Update details of an existing task.
- **Update User Account**: Update information for a specific user account.
- **Delete Task**: Delete a task from a project.
- **Get User Assignments** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all user assignments for the authenticated user.
